# Wagner College Athletics

> > Official athletics website for Wagner College Seahawks, featuring Hall of Fame inductees, athlete biographies, and the history of Wagner's NCAA sports programs.

Wagner College Athletics represents the Seahawks across multiple sports including basketball, track and field, and other NCAA Division I programs. The site preserves the legacy of legendary athletes like Howard "Bones" Thompkins (NBA draft pick) and Charles "Lonny" West, chronicling decades of athletic excellence from the 1950s through the present day.

## Key Topics

- Wagner College Seahawks
- Hall of Fame inductees
- NCAA Division I athletics
- Basketball program history
- Howard "Bones" Thompkins
- Charles "Lonny" West
- NBA draft selections
- ECAC Metro Conference
- NIT tournament appearances
- Track and field
- 1950s-1980s athletics era
- Athlete biographies
- Historic achievements
- Athletic honors and awards

## Hall of Fame

- [Hall of Fame - Wagner College Athletics](https://wagnerathletics.com/honors/hall-of-fame/kiosk): Wagner College Athletics Hall of Fame main page with inductees & nominations
- [Howard "Bones" Thompkins (2003) - Hall of Fame](https://wagnerathletics.com/honors/hall-of-fame/howard-bones-thompkins/103): Hall of Fame profile: Howard 'Bones' Thompkins, basketball center (1985)
- [Charles "Lonny" West (1991) - Hall of Fame](https://wagnerathletics.com/hof.aspx?hof=12&path=&kiosk=): Hall of Fame profile: Charles 'Lonny' West, basketball player (1958)
